crossRefs.note: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal…
O Yahweh, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’…

translations.web: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear Yahweh God.”
translations.bsb: But as for you and your officials, I know that you still do not fear the LORD our God.”
translations.kjv: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.
translations.asv: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear Jehovah God.
